channel.title: Nolan Kido | Writing across the site
channel.description: Published writing from Notes, Living Well, and Poker. Original dates and links, in one feed. Proposed experiments and directory changes are not included.

item.title: Let AI do more. Keep the judgment.
item.description: Delegating production is not the same as handing over responsibility. An essay on purpose, boundaries, permission, and the choices worth keeping human.

item.title: Did the tool actually make life easier?
item.description: Review a small technology change by its real purpose, total effort, reliability, privacy, and effect on other people, not just its impressive output.

item.title: Find the document you need without uploading your whole life

item.title: Reflect with AI without handing over your judgment
